title: 'Bihar, Maha, Delhi, Haryana & Bengal': Oppn seeks repolls after EC 'dissent' report
content: Tejashwi Yadav has accused the Election Commission of being under BJP's influence to achieve electoral victories across various states. He also expressed his worries regarding the modifications to the voting records' retention period. Additionally, DMK chief MK Stalin has joined the call for the ousting of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, citing election discrepancies, while former West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee condemned the Commission’s management of voting lists.

title: 'Deliberations sign of pure democracy': BJP reacts to EC 'SIR split' row, targets Cong
content: BJP MP Sambit Patra defended the Election Commission's internal discussions as a sign of democracy. He accused opposition parties, particularly Congress, of undermining constitutional institutions due to electoral defeats. Patra highlighted that criticism of the Election Commission indicates a broader campaign against democratic bodies. He emphasized that the opposition's attacks are inappropriate and calls into question their respect for established institutions.

title: Staff at AI companies under mental strain over working on tech that may kill humans
content: Employees in leading AI organizations are experiencing increased mental stress due to fears about societal harm from their projects. Reports indicate that burnout and low morale are prevalent due to expedited evaluation timelines and rapid deployments. Workers have voiced concerns regarding corporate culture and management decisions in sensitive tech projects. Many specialists have resigned, citing significant risks associated with AI advancements.

title: 'We were really looking forward to Japan': Teary-eyed Manu Bhaker remembers Rana
content: As Manu Bhaker walked into the mixed zone after the final, it was evident she was struggling to hold back her emotions. She managed to do so until the conversation turned to Rana, who passed away in June. Rana, one of the most decorated shooters in Asian Games history with eight medals, including four gold across three editions, had missed the Hangzhou Games as he was not part of the Indian contingent.

title: What's Suwalki gap? Europe's 'achilles heel' that it fears could be Putin's target
content: Saudi Arabia has asked the US to carry out repeated air strikes against the Houthis, according to a person familiar with the discussions. Washington has so far declined, leaving Riyadh to confront an expanding threat largely on its own. The hesitation is particularly significant for Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, who has spent years relying on the US as Saudi Arabia’s main security partner.

title: F-35, Rafale, Tejas in one battlespace: Tarang Shakti brings the world's air power to India
content: The Indian Air Force is hosting the second edition of Tarang Shakti from September 26 to October 11. Nearly 40 air forces from various countries, including the United States and France, are participating in this exercise. This initiative aims to enhance military interoperability and share operational best practices among global air forces. The presence of advanced aircraft like the F-35 highlights the significance of this training.

title: Salesforce CEO blames Microsoft for not investing in OpenAI
content: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says Microsoft's stake in OpenAI stopped his company from investing in the ChatGPT maker. Speaking on Alex Heath's Sources podcast, Benioff said Sam Altman turned him down, pushing Salesforce towards rival Anthropic. That early 2023 bet is reportedly worth about $5 billion, and Benioff believes it could earn Salesforce tens of billions as Claude maker Anthropic prepares for a public listing.

title: Security guard 'kisses' Hyderabad techie after cab ride to hostel, held
content: In Hyderabad, a private security guard has been arrested for allegedly molesting a 26-year-old software engineer. The incident took place when the accused reportedly grabbed and kissed the woman as she exited her cab. Police have registered a case under relevant sections of the law, including sexual harassment. The security guard, however, denies the allegation and claims he only helped her after she fell.

title: Who holds the leverage? Five cards Trump and Xi bring to the table
content: The anticipated meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping on September 24 serves as a platform to confront escalating tensions. Each leader arrives with their own strategic advantages in the realms of trade and technology, potentially shaping the discussions ahead. The intricate matters concerning Taiwan and rare earth supply chains will add layers of complexity to the talks.

title: Alonzo Mourning's $37.4M project offers seniors apartments from $322
content: After his NBA career, Alonzo Mourning founded AM Affordable Housing to address the pressing need for affordable homes in South Florida. Through collaboration with Housing Trust Group, he has spearheaded various projects, including the Astoria on 9th, which boasts 120 affordable apartments in Bradenton. With overwhelming demand and countless applicants vying for limited options, Mourning draws on his foster care history to fuel his philanthropic mission.

title: Petrol, diesel margins may jump in Q2FY27, but LPG losses to cap OMC gains: Report
content: India's oil marketing companies are projected to experience improved petrol and diesel margins in Q2FY27. Although LPG sales are expected to incur significant losses, the recovery in oil margins remains promising. Refined product supply disruptions contribute to the strong margins in the near term. However, the recovery is sensitive to fluctuations in crude oil prices and government policies.

title: Kashmiri activist slams Pakistan at UNHRC over PoK protest crackdown
content: At the UN Human Rights Council, Tasleema Akhtar, a dedicated Kashmiri activist, called attention to the pressing human rights issues in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir. She outlined the severe lack of basic infrastructure and essential services for PoK residents in contrast to those in the Jammu and Kashmir Union Territory.

title: Watch: Apache firepower joins US war machines during India-US drill Yudh Abhyas
content: Apache attack helicopters of the Indian Army are currently participating in Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026 with US forces. This joint exercise is taking place at Mahajan Field Firing Range in Rajasthan and Auli in Uttarakhand. Around 600 personnel from both nations are involved in various operations, including mountain warfare and live-fire activities. The Apache helicopters are demonstrating capabilities in target acquisition and precision engagement during these drills.

title: T'gana lecturer kills engineering student after she befriended another man
content: In a tragic turn of events, 20-year-old engineering student Tandhra Akshitharani was reportedly killed by her former lecturer, Jetty Naveen Kumar. Following revelations of her sexual exploitation by colleague Bommakanthi Ravikumar, she was coerced into ingesting pesticide. Attempting to disguise the act as a suicide, Kumar fled after alerting her father. Sadly, Akshitharani succumbed to her injuries at a government hospital, with both Kumar and Ravikumar now in police custody.

title: Brittany Mahomes’ biggest brand deals: From SKIMS to Alani Nu
content: Brittany Mahomes has built a growing business portfolio beyond her connection to Patrick Mahomes. With an estimated $15 million net worth and reported million-dollar endorsement earnings, she has partnered with brands including Divi, SKIMS, Alani Nu, Adidas and Abercrombie. Her commercial ventures, fashion collaborations and Kansas City Current ownership further expand her business presence, establishing her as a prominent figure in sports, lifestyle and brand marketing.

title: Giants linked to $33M Cardinals QB amid Jaxson Dart injury concern
content: Jaxson Dart may miss a long time for knee injury, surgery, and recovery. The New York Giants need a stopgap solution. They cannot depend solely on Jameis Winston. Arizona Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew II could be a viable option. He played backup for Patrick Mahomes in 2025. He comes a consistent 80.0 to 100.0 passer rating throughout his seven-year career.

title: 'Differing views normal part of deliberation': EC responds after report flags rift over SIR
content: The Election Commission of India addressed concerns regarding differing opinions among its members during the Special Intensive Revision process. It emphasised that such differences are normal in decision-making and all final decisions are taken unanimously. The Commission criticised media reports highlighting isolated internal notes while neglecting overall approvals and initiatives. Opposition leaders have intensified their criticism, alleging that the revision targets specific elector groups favorable to the BJP.

title: Railway tracks capable of 130 kmph speed rise 5x in 12 years, but punctuality is 77%
content: According to recent Ministry of Railways data released, about 54,600 km of railway tracks were renewed between 2014 and February 2026, with track renewal and upgrading being carried out based on factors such as the age, traffic load and condition of the track.

title: Banks to open on Sunday ahead of 3-day nationwide strike: What customers should know
content: Banks will remain open on Sunday, September 27, to ensure public access to essential services and mitigate disruptions. The United Forum of Bank Unions plans a nationwide strike from September 28 to 30 due to ongoing demands. Customers could face a five-day disruption in services, as the strike follows a weekend holiday. Key demands include the introduction of five-day banking and improvements in pension schemes for employees.

title: After 28 years, Mirabai Chanu finally puts India back on Asian Games weightlifting podium
content: With India's hopes resting on her shoulders, the Tokyo Olympic silver medallist Mirabai Chanu lifted 198kg to win silver in the women's 49kg event at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya. It was India's first Asian Games weightlifting medal since Karnam Malleswari won silver at the 1998 Bangkok Games.

title: Want to invest in real estate without buying a house? India’s REIT market is booming
content: India's Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) are capturing the spotlight as the market witnesses significant expansion. Investors have the opportunity to acquire shares in publicly traded REITs or enhance their portfolios through mutual funds and ETFs, promoting diversification. The growth is further fueled by increasing office space availability and strong demand from multinational firms, making the REIT landscape a compelling investment option for individuals and institutions alike.

title: 'This is treason': Rahul revives 'vote chori' charge after report of rift within EC

These accusations arose after a report revealed dissent among Election Commissioners. Veteran Congress leaders echoed this sentiment, urging a parliamentary review. In response, the Election Commission refuted any internal conflicts, asserting that all decisions were made collectively and in strict adherence to legal protocols and Supreme Court directives.

title: 'Strategic desperation': Iran on Trump's 'annihilate Islamic Republic' remark
content: Iranian military authorities said Trump's remarks showed the difficulties facing the US in its confrontation with Iran. They argued that repeated threats were not evidence of American strength, but reflected what they described as exhaustion within the US military. The statement also accused the US of creating instability in West Asia through its military presence in the region.

title: Half-burnt body of woman found in UP, toddler found crying nearby

The police suspect the woman was strangled before her body was transported to the field. Authorities are attempting to identify the woman and investigate the circumstances surrounding her death.

title: Bank stopped widow from accessing matured FDs; commission orders Rs 13.87L payment

The woman needed the funds for her mother's medical treatment and gold loan repayment. Despite the bank's claims of irregularities, the district consumer commission found they provided inadequate justification. The commission awarded the woman Rs 13.87 lakh and additional compensation for her distress.

title: 'UP ke ladke' in for political 'brawl'? SP, Cong spar over who can beat BJP in 2027
content: the "UP ke ladke" bonhomie is beginning to look less like a united front . Congress and Samajwadi Party leaders trading jabs over who can take on the BJP in 2027 . Iqra Hasan set off the latest bout of sparring by saying Congress "can't achieve much on its own"

title: New Zealand spent 14 years restoring Abel Tasman and its native wildlife
content: a 14-year restoration effort began in new Zealand’s Abel Tasman . it had the appearance of an intact landscape when Project Janszoon was established . the park had lost much of its natural richness to introduced predators and invasive plants .

title: New Hampshire man returns magazine 132 years late, avoids $12,055 fine
content: John Hanson, 84, recently brought a September 1894 issue of The Century Illustrated Monthly magazine back to the Concord Public Library . the publication had remained in his home for decades, although he had no idea how it came into his possession . his decision to return it followed the library's introduction of a year-long fine freeze .

title: Pennsylvania buyer’s $4 painting hid a 1776 Declaration copy worth $8.14m
content: a $4 flea-market purchase in Pennsylvania turned into one of the most remarkable discoveries in American history . in 1989, a man bought a framed painting mainly because he wanted the frame . when he later took it apart, he found a folded document hidden behind the canvas .

title: 'Arrest poll panel chief': Mamata demands Bengal repoll amid EC 'SIR split' row
content: former chief minister Mamata banerjee demands fresh elections in west Bengal . she says there will be "pan-India protests till Gyanesh Kumar remains CEC" a report claims two Election Commissioners raised objections to aspects of the voter-roll exercise .

title: Nandigram bypoll: Cong candidate Milan Pradhan sent to judicial custody till October 7
content: a court in west Bengal's Purba Medinipur district sent Milan Pradhan to judicial custody until October 7 a day after voting in connection with a 2007 criminal case . the additional Chief Judicial Magistrate of Contai Court remanded the Congress candidate to the upcoming bypoll .

title: Putin's party wins again as expected. So why does Russia still hold elections?
content: why does a Russian vote actually matter? the result gives United Russia 355 of the 450 seats in the State Duma . the result is hardly the mystery . a simple question is why the system makes a genuine change of power extremely unlikely .

title: BJP appoints incharges and co-incharges for 28 states, 8 UTs: Full list
content: Vinod tawde has been appointed as the incharge of UP . Vinay Sahastrabuddhe was named Delhi incharge . party leader smriti Irani given the responsibility of Chhattisgarh and Haryana .

title: Michigan photographer gets 5 years for $4.6M scam, $200K Taylor Swift tickets
content: photographer Chanise Coyne, 46, pleaded guilty to wire fraud on may 19, 2026 . she falsely claimed the money would cover advance fees for the family's young daughter's participation in modelling events across the us .

title: Israeli soldier accused of Gaza war crimes leaves India after complaint: Report
content: the soldier, whose identity has not been made public, left India in mid-September . it remains unclear whether the complaint influenced his departure or whether he left after completing his holiday . the move comes amid renewed calls for countries to uphold international law .

title: Validity of CEC appointment law: SC split over Constitution Bench referral
content: the selection panel comprises the prime minister, a union cabinet minister and the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha . the centre's argument against the collegium system for appointing judges is a myth . justice dipankar Datta said there was no need to refer the case to the constitution bench .

title: 'Unwarranted': India rejects OIC's Kashmir references, takes shot at Pakistan
content: the ministry of external affairs said the entire Union territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are an “integral and inalienable part of India” . the response came after a ministerial meeting of the OIC Contact Group . deputy prime minister and foreign minister Mohammad Ishaq Dar urged member states to maintain a “unified position” on jammu .
